## 提交检查 / Submission checklist

- [ ] 我有权以本项目 AGPL-3.0 许可提交这些改动；第三方代码、数据或资产已注明来源及许可。 / I have the right to submit these changes under the project's AGPL-3.0 license; third-party code, data or assets have their sources and licenses identified.
- [ ] 未包含私人出生资料、凭据、本地数据库或未经授权的图片。 / No private birth records, credentials, local databases or unauthorized images are included.
- [ ] 已说明必要的测试、文档更新和兼容性影响；不适用的项目已注明。 / Relevant validation, documentation and compatibility impacts are described, with inapplicable items noted.
